agent.runner_summary: The adapter runs the AIbitat session underlying AgentHandler with USER -> @agent and a local deterministic provider.

log_notes: AIbitat records messages in its chats array; the adapter returns the final @agent message.
Production AgentHandler resolves workspace, persistence, plugins, and provider configuration before creating AIbitat; those mutable boundaries are intentionally not part of the simulator turn.
learning_env_guidance: Use a raw string fixed turn: the public adapter input is an AnythingLLM workspace-agent prompt.
No named agent target is available. The adapter uses a local provider and no tools, so smoke and learning environments need no provider credentials or mocks.
Workspace file context is application-managed. If a learning environment models file-backed prompts, embed the relevant contents into the prompt rather than passing a local path.
